sobre.title: About LandMap
sobre.description: LandMap raises the Brazilian real estate territory as open data — price per m², heatmaps and AI for decisions, free and without login.
sobre.f1: Mission: make the square-meter price transparent across every city in Brazil.
sobre.f2: Data: property catalog across 20+ cities with price history and heat layers.
sobre.f3: Open: no paywall — the map and indicators stay open for any user.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How we collect, use and protect your data on LandMap.
privacy.f1: Collection: we collect only the minimum needed to run the map and account.
privacy.f2: Use: your data is never sold and is used to improve the experience.
privacy.f3: Rights: you may request export or deletion at any time.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: Conditions for using the LandMap platform.
terms.f1: Use: content is informational and not advice.
terms.f2: Account: you are responsible for your account and data security.
terms.f3: Limitation: LandMap is not liable for decisions based on the data.

fontes.title: Data Sources
fontes.description: Where LandMap properties, prices and indicators come from.
fontes.f1: Catalog: properties aggregated from public portals and open market bases.
fontes.f2: Price/m²: computed per region from recent transactions and listings.
fontes.f3: Refresh: the dataset is recomputed periodically to reflect the market.

splash.title: Real estate territory, raised as data.
splash.subtitle: Interactive map, price per m² and AI for decisions — free and no login.
